title: Tendency
description: A behavioral tendency under observation (ADR-013 T3), e.g. novelty_seeking, persistence-under-challenge. NOT a personality label and never a conclusion: an open-vocabulary trait name plus the accumulating evidence for/against it. Lives in the Insight layer only — never a Reducer signal channel (ADR-004 discipline).

trait.description: Open vocabulary (e.g. 'novelty_seeking', 'verbal_persistence'). A hypothesis under observation, not a diagnosis.

summary.description: What was observed (zh), e.g. 'chose the unknown cave path'.

direction.description: Contradicting evidence lowers confidence and can mark the tendency stale.

status.description: emerging: few observations; stable: repeatedly reinforced; stale: contradicted or unreinforced — history wins.
